verdict.rationale: Exa documents its own background automation: scheduled searches that surface new web events (exa-docs-10), async deep research, list building and enrichment (exa-docs-9), Websets that search, verify and enrich results automatically (exa-docs-15, exa-docs-8), and real-time HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched (exa-docs-21). However, the scheduling capability appears only as a one-line pricing mention, and one hands-on Websets run was reported stuck on 'Verifying...' for minutes (exa-comm-3), which raises reliability questions without contradicting the feature. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring schedules or monitor cadence, evidence of how automations are created and managed (triggers, run history, failure handling), and independent corroboration that scheduled runs work unattended.
